duration: Workdays are monthly. Cancelled when it is below zero.
name: Volunteer Restoration Workdays (all ages)
org: Forest Preserve District of Kane County
what_you_do: Join a monthly restoration workday in the forest preserves. Volunteers work in natural areas. Longer roles include trail adopter and nature center host. You can also be a historic site guide or help at special events.
who_can_apply: Workdays are described as for all ages, individuals and families. No sign up needed unless you come with a group of 10 or more. Age rules for the longer volunteer roles are not on the pages read.
deadline_text: No deadline. See the monthly list of workdays on the volunteer page.
how_to_apply: For workdays, just show up 5 to 10 minutes early and sign in with the leader. For longer roles, fill out the volunteer application on the site. Volunteer Office: 630-762-2741, volunteer@kaneforest.com.
notes: Bring boots or sturdy shoes, a water bottle and gloves. Info on Eagle Scout and Gold Award projects is in the Resources section of the volunteer page. Questions about workdays: Stewardship Specialist, 630-200-1290.
